headline: Ownership Fronts Surge Across Mooring and Weathered
war_summary: The latest returns mark a sharper ownership contest in Mooring County and Weathered Expanse. Mooring logged 53 strategic-base events in 24 hours, including nine in the latest two-hour watch; its ledger now stands at six Colonial, five Warden and one neutral holding, with casualties and enlistments still accelerating. Weathered recorded 57 daily events and 13 in two hours, while its nine bases are divided three apiece among Colonial, Warden and neutral control; both casualty streams are rising sharply. Linn Mercy remains a principal battlefield, with 42 events in the day and eight in the last two hours. Its present count is seven Colonial, two Warden and two neutral sites, alongside accelerating casualties and enlistments. Callums Cape has cooled to 19 daily events, though two arrived in the latest watch and the map remains divided five Colonial, one Warden and one neutral. Marban Hollow retains 12 daily events but none in two hours. Lykos Isle, with nine daily events, is quieter at present. Most other regions report no recent ownership activity, leaving these six fronts the clearest watches for the next edition.
